items.raw_excerpt: Multiple areas of Denmark, particularly in the west, could see half a month of rain fall this week due to a low pressure front moving towards Denmark from France causing rain and strong winds.
items.summary_en: A low pressure front is moving toward Denmark from France. It will bring rain and strong winds. Western parts of the country may see half a month of rain in one week.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스에서 덴마크로 저기압 전선이 이동하고 있습니다. 이로 인해 비와 강한 바람이 불 것으로 보입니다. 특히 서부 지역은 일주일 만에 보름치 비가 내릴 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Half a Month of Rain Expected This Week in Parts of Denmark
items.title_ko: 덴마크 일부 지역, 이번 주에 한 달치 절반의 비 예상
items.title_original: Half a month of rain set to fall this week in parts of Denmark

items.raw_excerpt: The third week of October is Denmark’s ‘efterårsferie’ or autumn holiday, with schools closed and many people travelling for a few days away. Here’s how that could affect traffic.
items.summary_en: The third week of October is Denmark's autumn holiday, called efterårsferie. Schools close and many families travel for a few days. This can cause heavy traffic on the roads.
items.summary_ko: 10월 셋째 주는 덴마크의 가을 방학인 에프테로스페리에입니다. 학교가 문을 닫아 많은 가족이 며칠 동안 여행을 떠납니다. 그래서 도로가 많이 막힐 수 있습니다.

items.title_ko: 덴마크 가을 방학에 도로가 붐빕니다
items.title_original: Where and when to expect heavy traffic during Denmark's 2026 autumn holiday

items.raw_excerpt: Sau sáp nhập, khu vực phía nam của thành phố Đà Nẵng có rất nhiều tiềm năng, lợi thế để phát triển du lịch cộng đồng. Vì vậy, Đà Nẵng vừa ban hành kế hoạch phát triển du lịch trọng điểm ở khu vực này theo hướng bền vững, lấy cộng đồng làm trung tâm, phát huy giá trị tài nguyên và bản sắc văn hóa địa phương.
items.summary_en: Da Nang has announced a plan to develop tourism in its southern area. The plan focuses on community-based and sustainable travel. It aims to highlight local culture and natural resources in Hương Trà.

items.title_en: Da Nang plans community tourism in its southern area

items.raw_excerpt: Nessa terça-feira (6), o destaque foi a bicampeã paralímpica Mariana D'Andrea, que bateu o próprio recorde do continente.
items.summary_en: Brazil is on top of the medals table at the Americas Open in para powerlifting. On Tuesday, two-time Paralympic champion Mariana D'Andrea broke her own continental record. The team has won seven gold medals so far.
items.summary_ko: 브라질이 장애인 파워리프팅 아메리카 오픈 메달 순위에서 1위를 달리고 있다. 화요일에는 패럴림픽 2관왕 마리아나 단드레아가 자신의 대륙 기록을 갈아치웠다. 브라질은 지금까지 금메달 7개를 땄다.
items.title_en: Brazil leads Americas Open in para powerlifting with seven golds

items.raw_excerpt: Blacky (Mum) and Browny (Daughter) are both sterilised, vaccinated and chipped.
items.summary_en: A mother dog named Blacky and her daughter Browny are looking for a new home. Both are sterilised, vaccinated, and chipped. They hope to stay together.

items.raw_excerpt: Six months after Aboriginal human remains were found at the site, authorities have officially put an end to the works.
items.summary_en: Workers found Aboriginal human remains at a bus stop site on Rottnest Island. Six months later, officials have stopped the building work for good. The island is near Perth in Western Australia.
items.summary_ko: 호주 로트네스트 섬의 버스 정류장 공사 현장에서 원주민 유해가 발견됐다. 6개월 뒤 당국은 이 공사를 완전히 멈추기로 했다. 로트네스트 섬은 서호주 퍼스 근처에 있는 섬이다.

items.raw_excerpt: Breast cancer screenings, exhibitions and charity events are taking place across the region to raise awareness.
items.summary_en: The Algarve region is holding breast cancer screenings, exhibitions and charity events this month. The events aim to raise awareness about breast cancer. Local groups joined together for the campaign.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 알가르베 지역에서 이번 달 유방암 검진과 전시, 자선 행사가 열린다. 이 행사들은 유방암에 대한 인식을 높이기 위해 마련됐다. 지역 단체들이 힘을 모아 캠페인에 참여했다.

items.summary_en: A housing firm called Beyond Housing said sorry after a worker called a tenant a tramp. The company said the comment and the worker's mocking behaviour were not acceptable. It has promised to look into what happened.

items.raw_excerpt: Für den niederländischen DJ und Produzenten Talismann ist Musik eine grenzenlose Spielwiese für klangliche Erkundungen. Immer tiefer dringt er in die Abgründe düsterer Soundscapes und industrieller Drum-Patterns vor.
items.summary_en: Talismann is a Dutch DJ and producer. He treats music as a wide-open playground for sound experiments. His set digs deep into dark soundscapes and industrial drum patterns.

items.title_original: Talismann - Stone Techno 2023 - Programm in voller Länge | ARTE Concert - Arte TV.

items.raw_excerpt: Wondering when schools are off in Germany? We've put together a handy guide for the coming term so you can plan the year ahead.
items.summary_en: A guide lists the school holiday dates across Germany for the 2026 to 2027 term. Parents can use it to plan family time and trips ahead. The dates vary from state to state.
items.summary_ko: 2026년부터 2027년까지 독일 각 주의 학교 방학 날짜를 한눈에 정리한 안내서가 나왔다. 학부모들은 이를 보고 가족 여행과 일정을 미리 계획할 수 있다. 방학 날짜는 주마다 조금씩 다르다.

items.raw_excerpt: Autumn is here and that means harvest time for many fruits and vegetables in Spain. But, it’s also one of the best times of year for foraging, including for wild mushrooms, chestnuts and wild berries.
items.summary_en: Autumn has arrived in Spain. This is a great season to pick wild mushrooms, chestnuts and wild berries. A local guide shares tips on foraging for them.

items.summary_en: This Norwegian phrase helps you express yourself to friends and colleagues when times are tough. It literally means to meet the wall. It describes hitting a wall and feeling completely worn out.

items.raw_excerpt: Austria may still have a reputation for paper-heavy bureaucracy, but a growing number of official apps and websites can make everyday administration much easier.
items.summary_en: Austria is known for heavy paperwork and slow bureaucracy. But a growing number of official apps and websites now help people handle daily admin tasks more easily. These tools can save time on common government errands.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아는 서류가 많고 행정 절차가 느린 곳으로 알려져 있다. 하지만 요즘은 관공서 앱과 웹사이트가 늘어나서 각종 행정 업무를 더 쉽게 처리할 수 있다. 이런 도구들은 자주 하는 관청 일의 시간을 줄여 준다.

items.title_original: The apps and websites that make Austrian bureaucracy easier

items.raw_excerpt: Os primeiros cinco dias de outubro, no concelho da Madalena, na ilha do Pico, ficam para a história como a celebração de cordofones, Cordas World Music Festival, conhecido localmente como Festival Cordas.
items.summary_en: A music festival took over Madalena on Pico Island for the first five days of October. It celebrated stringed instruments and brought together old music, improvisation, and people from many cultures.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 피쿠 섬의 마달레나에서 10월 첫 닷새 동안 음악 축제가 열렸다. 이 축제는 현악기를 주제로 옛 음악과 즉흥 연주, 여러 문화의 만남을 선보였다.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan Railway Corp. (TR) has apologized after a northbound Puyuma Express train failed to stop at Jiaoxi Station in Yilan on Wednesday, forcing it to reverse back to Jiaoxi to let passengers on and off.
items.summary_en: A northbound Puyuma Express train did not stop at Jiaoxi Station in Yilan, Taiwan. The train reversed back to the station so passengers could get on and off. Taiwan Railway apologized for the mistake.
items.summary_ko: 대만 이란의 자오시역에서 푸유마 열차가 정차하지 않고 지나쳤다. 열차는 승객들이 타고 내릴 수 있도록 다시 역으로 되돌아갔다. 대만 철도는 이 실수에 대해 사과했다.
items.title_en: Train Misses Its Stop, Then Backs Up to Fix It
items.title_ko: 기차가 역을 그냥 지나쳐, 다시 뒤로 갔다
items.title_original: Taiwan Railway apologizes after train blows past station

items.raw_excerpt: Do arroz-doce de casamento de Eira Pedrinha às receitas de outros tempos, esta oficina que acontece a 16 de outubro,…
items.summary_en: A village in Condeixa, Portugal will hold a workshop on October 16. People will learn to make the traditional wedding rice pudding of Eira Pedrinha. Old family recipes will also be shared.

items.raw_excerpt: Two French MPs have proposed changing the Constitution to give regional languages such as Basque and Breton greater legal protection.
items.summary_en: Two French lawmakers want to change the Constitution. They hope this will protect regional languages like Basque and Breton. The idea is still only a proposal.

items.raw_excerpt: Heavy tax obligations and deteriorating healthcare, as well as growing political uncertainty, are among the factors Italy’s would-be foreign residents say are delaying their plans to move.
items.summary_en: People who planned to move to Italy are waiting longer. They say high taxes and weaker healthcare are the main reasons. Growing political uncertainty also makes them slow down.
items.summary_ko: 이탈리아로 이사하려던 외국인들이 계획을 미루고 있다. 높은 세금과 나빠진 의료 서비스가 주된 이유로 꼽힌다. 커지는 정치적 불확실성도 이들의 발걸음을 늦추고 있다.

items.title_ko: 이탈리아로 이사 가려던 사람들이 망설이는 이유
items.title_original: High taxes and healthcare: Why people are holding off on moving to Italy

items.raw_excerpt: Até o próximo sábado, serão exibidas sete obras contemporâneas. A entrada é gratuita, com distribuição de ingressos 1 hora antes do filme.
items.summary_en: A Colombian film festival starts this Wednesday in Sao Paulo. Seven contemporary films will be shown until Saturday. Entry is free, and tickets are given out one hour before each film.
